steps.content:
The root cause is instance family **fG8wYOz6XO** (application qnK, cloud service wpLAB). It cost $453.60 on 2025-10-16 when about $277 was expected.

**How I found it:** I filtered data.csv to account JUNpaMa and broke daily cost down by cloud service, application and instance family. Almost all of the movement around this date sits in cloud service wpLAB and application qnK. Within qnK, two instance families account for nearly all of it: fG8wYOz6XO and g9c1yzr6KG. Every other instance family stays flat at a few dollars a day.

**Separating the two:** Both families go up and down every week, so I compared 10-16 with the same weekday in earlier weeks. Prices didn't change (1.05 and 1.41), so cost moved only with instance count.

| Instance family | Normal Thursday cost (instances) | 2025-10-16 cost (instances) | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| fG8wYOz6XO | $277.20 (11) on 9/4, 9/18 and 10/2 | $453.60 (18) | About 64% above normal. This is the anomaly. |
| g9c1yzr6KG | $744–$778 (22–23) | $744.48 (22) | Normal for a Thursday. Not a cause. |

fG8wYOz6XO ran 18 instances, a count it normally reaches only on Mondays and Tuesdays. It stayed at that level on 10-17 and then dropped to zero on 10-18.
